# Jaeger Service
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.jaeger.service` |
| Source | `09_docker/docker.jaeger.service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, observability |
Jaeger all-in-one tracing backend with OTLP receivers enabled. Used to collect
distributed traces from the content graph services for debugging and analysis.
